palette.notes: Measured 22 colours, 2 ramps, median hue shift 40 (strongly hue-shifted), ramp length 11. Saturated yellow-greens for grass and ivy, warm beige houses, shadows go to blue-green and grey.

lighting: Bright overcast daylight with soft top light; foliage highlights pushed to yellow, shade to cool green. In 3D the lighting is shared by everything, so shadows are consistent.
silhouette: A man with a backpack, side-on, small against the house; clear walking silhouette. Houses read as big blocky masses.

motion.timing: Phone filming a monitor, so code numbers (599 changes, 29.93/s, on 1s) are mostly the camera and screen, not drawings. The character walks with smooth game-engine animation.

texture: Voxel/3D scene rendered with pixel-art texture: blocky pixel foliage and brick, then shown from a tilted 3D angle (the 'work smart' reveal). Engine gizmos visible in editor view.
camera: Starts as a flat side-scroller view; mid-clip the editor camera swings to a top-down 3D angle revealing the scene is 3D, then returns to the side view.

acting.enters: Character walks in from the side in the game view.
acting.acts: Walks across the yard, stops; ordinary gameplay walk. The joke is the reveal of the 3D build behind the 2D look.
acting.exits: Walks out of frame to the right before the camera swings.
acting.depth: Foreground grass, mid-ground character, houses behind and more houses far back; real 3D depth gives free parallax.

techniques: 2D-looking pixel art built as a 3D/voxel scene for free parallax
hue-shifted foliage ramps (yellow lights, blue-green shade)
camera swing reveal: flat view turns into 3D
layered foreground grass in front of the character
behind-the-scenes editor view as the hook
feel: flat side view + 3D voxel world + yellow-to-teal foliage ramps + camera swing reveal = 'wait, it's 3D?' hook
for_fred: Give Fred layered depth: foreground grass or weeds in front, Fred in the middle, background far behind, and let him walk out of frame and come back. A cheap version: a 3-layer parallax pan when he exits, then cut back with him small in the background layer.
